note: Code Health scores from the CodeScene MCP, an in-session check at review time, deliberately not an sfl/CI gate (ported from another estate repository, adopted by Yves for forsgren 2026-10-02). Every Go change gets a CodeScene review before its FBP; the changed files' rows are updated at that hand-off. Floor: every file >= 9.0. minScore is a ratchet: a file below 10 floors at score - 0.1 but never below 9.0; a file at 10.0 floors at 10.0. A change must not drop a file below its minScore; lift minScore when a score improves. A row whose score is below its minScore is debt that must be fixed, not a floor to keep. Rules: .codescene/code-health-rules.json (cyclomatic complexity warning at 7, mirroring gocyclo). Sorted ascending by score.
scoredWith: CodeScene MCP, first baseline of all 27 Go files on 2026-10-02 under .codescene/code-health-rules.json. Re-baseline when the rules change, not on an engine bump.
